cases.name: new-teammate-credential
cases.prompt: I am a different developer using the same Headstart OpenAI project. My key is in my own 1Password. Can I use this skill?
expectedBehaviors: Uses the shared runtime and skill with the operator's own private profile, not another developer's reference
Requests only missing non-secret coordinates and confirms the expected Headstart account and project
Uses explicit config or the path-only HEADSTART_OPENAI_CONFIG and checks read preflight
Keeps any authorized personal instruction note local and never collects the API key in chat

cases.name: local-instructions-without-shell-environment
cases.prompt: The desktop app doesn't see my shell environment variable, but my local instructions name my private OpenAI profile and launcher.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the explicitly confirmed local launcher and absolute config path without changing global shell settings
Does not substitute desktop login, a teammate's key, or an ambient API key
Reports current-session preflight evidence without claiming writes or cross-login testing

cases.name: personal-login
cases.prompt: I'm signed into personal Codex. Check whether I can access our Headstart OpenAI development project.
expectedBehaviors: Uses the explicit private project profile and Headstart credential without changing desktop login
Runs only bounded reads and reports the returned project identity
Does not infer PHI workspace approval or write permissions

cases.name: partial-inventory
cases.prompt: List our saved agents, only the first page for now.
expectedBehaviors: Uses one bounded page and reports has_more without claiming a complete inventory
Keeps instructions and session content out of default output

cases.name: missing-runtime
cases.prompt: I updated the skills. Are the OpenAI credentials and runtime installed now?
expectedBehaviors: Separates skill installation, runtime readiness and provider access
Follows the canonical setup guide without inventing a credential or exposing one

cases.name: wrong-project
cases.prompt: Headstart access failed. Just use the personal project the plugin can see.
expectedBehaviors: Does not substitute a different organization or project for Headstart work
Reports the target mismatch and asks for the necessary corrected setup

cases.name: conceptual
cases.prompt: What is the difference between the Responses API and the Agents API?
expectedBehaviors: Uses official documentation without accessing private platform resources
